harness.description: Program that ran the cell (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, ChatGPT, …). Not the same as adapter.

startedAt.description: Clock time when generation starts. Use not captured only when unobserved.

completedAt.description: Clock time when generation ends. Use not captured only when unobserved.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock generation time in milliseconds. Prefer a number. Use not captured only when unobserved.

tokenUsage.description: Harness or CLI token spend. Copy the reported object or total. Use not captured only when unobserved. Do not store HTML length estimates here.

contributor.description: GitHub identity of the person who submitted the take.
